title: MS SQL Server
description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

  

* Role MS SQL Server Database Administrator
* Level JL3
* Locations Bangalore BLR Chennai CHN Pune PUNE
* Job Summary
* We are looking for a skilled MS SQL Server Database Administrator DBA to manage maintain optimize and support mission critical SQL Server database environments
* The ideal candidate should have hands on experience in database administration performance tuning backup and recovery high availability and production support in enterprise environments

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

  

* Key Responsibilities
* Administer monitor and maintain Microsoft SQL Server databases across development test and production environments
* Perform database installation configuration upgrades patching and migrations
* Implement and manage backup recovery and disaster recovery procedures
* Monitor database health performance and availability and proactively address issues
* Optimize database performance through query tuning indexing and resource management
* Configure and manage High Availability HA and Disaster Recovery DR solutions such as
* Always On Availability Groups
* Database Mirroring
* Log Shipping
* Replication
* Failover Clustering
* Manage database security user access roles permissions and compliance requirements
* Troubleshoot database related incidents and provide L2 L3 support
* Support application teams during deployments releases and database changes
* Automate routine administrative tasks using PowerShell T SQL or SQL Agent Jobs
* Create and maintain operational documentation SOPs and knowledge articles

  

**Technical Requirements:**
---------------------------

  

* Required Skills
* Strong hands on experience in Microsoft SQL Server Administration
* Experience with SQL Server 2016 2019 2022 environments
* Expertise in
* Database Installation Configuration
* Backup Recovery
* Database Performance Tuning
* Query Optimization
* Index Management
* High Availability Disaster Recovery
* Security Management
* Capacity Planning
* Strong knowledge of T SQL scripting and troubleshooting
* Experience with SQL Server Agent SSMS Profiler Extended Events and Performance Monitoring tools
* Knowledge of Windows Server administration fundamentals
* Experience in incident problem and change management processes
* Preferred Skills
* Exposure to Azure SQL Database Azure Managed Instance or cloud database platforms
* Experience with database monitoring tools such as Redgate SolarWinds DPA SentryOne or similar solutions
* Knowledge of PowerShell scripting and automation
* Understanding of DevOps and CI CD database deployment practices
* ITIL Foundation certification preferred

  

**Additional Responsibilities:**
--------------------------------

  

* Experience
* 2 4 years of relevant experience in MS SQL Server Database Administration
* Experience supporting production database environments with high availability requirements
* Educational Qualification
* Bachelor s Degree in Computer Science Information Technology Engineering or related field
* Soft Skills
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to work in a fast paced production support environment
* Strong ownership and customer centric mindset
* Ability to work in shifts and participate in on call support when required
* Primary Skill Technology Database Administration MS SQL Server
* Job Level JL3
* Locations Bangalore BLR Chennai CHN Pune PUNE
* Experience Range 2 4 Years

  

**Preferred Skills:**
---------------------


Technology\-\>Cloud Platform\-\>Databases on Azure\-\>Azure Managed Instance for Apache Cassandra,Technology\-\>Database\-\>Microsoft SQL Server,Technology\-\>DevOps\-\>DevOps Architecture Consultancy,Technology\-\>Mainframe Technologies\-\>CICS

title: Lotus Notes
description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

  

* Role Messaging Collaboration Administrator Domino Lotus Notes Server
* Level JL3 JL4
* Experience 1 to 6 yrs
* Locations Bangalore BLR Chennai CHN Pune PUNE
* Job Summary
* We are seeking an experienced Messaging Collaboration Administrator with strong expertise in HCL Domino IBM Lotus Notes Administration
* The candidate will be responsible for managing maintaining upgrading and supporting enterprise messaging and collaboration platforms ensuring high availability security performance and operational excellence

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

  

* Key Responsibilities
* Administer monitor and support HCL Domino IBM Lotus Notes Server environments
* Perform installation configuration migration upgrades and patch management of Domino servers
* Manage mail routing replication clustering and server performance tuning
* Troubleshoot and resolve production incidents service requests and problem tickets within SLA timelines
* Manage user administration activities including mailbox creation access management policies and security controls
* Implement and maintain Domino server security certificates and authentication mechanisms
* Perform backup recovery disaster recovery planning and business continuity activities
* Coordinate with infrastructure network security and application teams for issue resolution
* Create and maintain technical documentation SOPs and knowledge articles
* Participate in on call support and planned maintenance activities

  

**Technical Requirements:**
---------------------------

  

* Required Skills
* Strong hands on experience in HCL Domino IBM Lotus Notes Administration
* Experience managing Domino Mail Infrastructure in enterprise environments
* Knowledge of Domino server installation configuration upgrades and migrations
* Expertise in
* Domino Clustering
* Replication
* Mail Routing
* Directory Management
* Security Administration
* Performance Monitoring Tuning
* Experience with Windows and or Linux server environments
* Understanding of backup and recovery processes for Domino infrastructure
* Experience handling L2 L3 production support activities
* Good troubleshooting and analytical skills
* Preferred Skills
* Experience in Domino to Microsoft Exchange M365 migration projects
* Working knowledge of PowerShell or automation tools
* Exposure to messaging security solutions and compliance requirements
* ITIL Foundation certification
* HCL Domino Administration certifications preferred

  

**Additional Responsibilities:**
--------------------------------

  

* Soft Skills
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
* Strong problem solving and incident management abilities
* Ability to work in a 24x7 support environment if required
* Team player with customer focused mindset
* Primary Skill Technology Messaging and Collaboration Administration Domino Lotus Notes Server
